edge.signer: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US

command: $edge = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe'; $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $edge; [pscustomobject]@{ path=$edge; productVersion=(Get-Item -LiteralPath $edge).VersionInfo.ProductVersion; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $edge -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; signatureStatus=[string]$signature.Status; signer=$signature.SignerCertificate.Subject } | ConvertTo-Json
limits: Existing offline tooling only. No package install, browser download, unsafe flag or lifecycle prototype. Not production Node24 validation.
